message.Title: Public Preview: Service Bus SDK type bindings in Azure Functions for Node.js

Body.Content:
Azure Functions triggers and bindings enable you to easily integrate event and data sources with function applications.  

 

Now that SDK type bindings support for Azure Blob Storage is available, we’re also introducing support for Service Bus SDK type bindings in your Node.js function apps.  

 

This means in JavaScript or TypeScript function apps you can now interact with a ServiceBusMessageContext type offering advanced messaging functionality.  


Learn more:

  • SDK type bindings for Service Bus in JavaScript and TypeScript 
  • SDK type bindings for Service Bus in JavaScript and TypeScript samples
